title: “Posting AI slop like this is loser behavior”: Netizens react to Scooter Braun’s AI Dirty Dancing video
key_facts: Former talent manager and record executive Scooter Braun posted two AI-generated videos of himself dancing in the role of Johnny Castle, played by Patrick Swayze in the 1987 film Dirty Dancing.
His caption presented them as old videos from his mother's bungalow colony in the Catskills.
Several users, including a Threads user, criticised the post; comments called it 'AI slop' and mocked him.
Braun also uploaded the post to Instagram.
The rest of the article is about Braun's relationship with actress Sydney Sweeney, citing Page Six.
quote_evidence: Former talent manager, record executive, and investor Scooter Braun shared two AI-generated videos of himself dancing to a Dirty Dancing song, taking actor Patrick Swayze's place.
"Making money off of other people's talent to post an AI slop pipeline," another netizen commented.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows public backlash to AI-made videos that put a person into a famous film scene.
event_date: Braun post date not stated; reactions reported 9 Oct 2026
